description: This file defines the ToyVpnService class, which manages a VPN connection in an Android application. It handles starting, stopping, and maintaining VPN connections, including foreground notification management and connection lifecycle.

classes.name: ToyVpnService
classes.description: An Android service that manages VPN connections, handles foreground notifications, and responds to start/stop commands.

classes.name: Connection
classes.description: A helper class extending Pair to hold a Thread and ParcelFileDescriptor representing a VPN connection.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the service and creates a PendingIntent for configuration.

methods.name: onStartCommand
methods.description: Handles start commands to connect or disconnect the VPN.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up by disconnecting the VPN when the service is destroyed.

methods.name: handleMessage
methods.description: Displays messages via Toast and updates notifications based on connection state.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Starts the VPN connection, retrieves preferences, and initiates a new connection.

methods.name: startConnection
methods.description: Creates and starts a new thread for the VPN connection, sets up callbacks for connection establishment.

methods.name: setConnectingThread
methods.description: Sets the current connecting thread, interrupting the previous if any.

methods.name: setConnection
methods.description: Sets the current active connection, closing previous connection resources if necessary.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Stops the VPN connection and updates the service state.

methods.name: updateForegroundNotification
methods.description: Creates or updates the foreground notification indicating VPN status.
